notes: Minimum tool versions required to build Voland. Core is C11 strict. Emscripten >=6.0.9 is the version the DESIGN.md §24 flag spellings (-m64, -pthread) are verified against; older releases are unsupported. Node >=22.6 is required for --experimental-strip-types, used by `npm run test` to run platform/web/tests/unit/*.test.ts directly with no build step.
